modelmodelpostgres

None

Table

ARCS

Arcs bundle relationships emerging from one entity together. Only one of the relationships set at a given timepoint.

All relationships in a ARC have to be of the same MAPTYPE and have the same MANDATORY-value at the end of the entity the ARC is defined for.

Subtype of MODELELEMENT. ARCS_ID is always identical to the corresponding MODE_ID

ARCS_UC *de* ARCS_UC VARCHAR (30) R

ATTRIBUTES

Description of a property, bearer of a value

Subtype of MODELELEMENT. ATTR_ID is always identical to the corresponding MODE_ID

Information

Dev. Status CRUD updated
None R stb, 2020-02-03 20:18:16 UTC
Name Description Domain Datatype R/W
ATTR_ID *de* ID NUMERIC (10,0) R
ATTR_ENTI_ID *de* ID NUMERIC (10,0) R
ATTR_DOMA_ID *de* ID NUMERIC (10,0) R
ATTR_TECH_NAME unique (technical) name of the attribute (column name are usually derived from it) *de* Name String (60) R
ATTR_DISPL_NAME Name to name the attribute on reports and forms (subject to be translated) *de* ATTR_DISPL_NAME VARCHAR (4000) R
ATTR_DISPL_SEQ number (1..n) describing the sequence of attributes if they are displayed *de* SequenzNr NUMERIC (5,0 >= 1 <= 99999) R
ATTR_TOOLTIP Tooltip to be shown, in screens (subject to translation) *de* ATTR_TOOLTIP CLOB (Grafik, ) R
ATTR_DESCR Description of usage, meaning of attribute (subject to be translated) *de* ATTR_DESCR CLOB (Grafik, ) R
ATTR_IS_DESCRIPTIVE Attribute is descriptive (meaning it helps understand the meaning of the entity). *de* Boolean String (5) R
ATTR_IS_MANDATORY *de* Boolean String (5) R
ATTR_IS_HISTORICISED Attribute value can change over time. Has to be resolved with additional table or storage. *de* Boolean String (5) R
ATTR_IS_REPEATED Attribute can have several values (of the same domain). Has to be resolved with addition table. *de* Boolean String (5) R
ATTR_IS_TRANSLATED Attribute value is subject to translation. Has to be implemented with an additional (probably generic) table. *de* Boolean String (5) R
ATTR_IS_ENCRYPTED Atttibute values have to be stored encrypted *de* Boolean String (5) R

DOMAINGROUP_MEMBERS

There are attributes, consisting of elements, but in the entity they are treated like one attribute.

Examples:
coordinates consisting for X and Y dimension (or longitude and lattitude)
houseidentification consisting of streetname and housenumber
timeperiod consisting of startdate and enddate (or startdate and duration)

A group element has a name, an optionality and a domain.
They can be implemented in a physical model as columns (like attributes). In this case they inherit all properties of the attribute associated with the group domain.
Or they can be implemented as compound (structured) type, it the dbms allows this.
